name: 夕阳再现III之炎龙封印
english_name: Sunset Reappears III: Seal of the Fire Dragon
english_description: The full title is "Sunset Reappears III: Seal of the Fire Dragon," made in 2006 by AKAI Studio; the actual site name shown on login is "Jianghu Storm." It's a representative example of classic domestic MudOS wuxia MUDs, built around traditional sects and internal-power cultivation. This archive is nearly identical to the sibling archive xysylmhb — matching .lpc file counts, directory structure, and map content — and was likely split from the same original package into two separate archives here; its map actually belongs to the unrelated "Tianya" lineage rather than the true Sunset Reappears bloodline, a reminder that shared branding doesn't reliably indicate shared code in this batch of games.
